scope: slice 3: the Clip inspector on the ordinary v2 editor route - selection-bound timing, Pattern instance sharing, Replace Pattern with animation-loss confirmation, appearance and Effects, and the Group actions, all through the closed prepared-edit admission
invariants: Sharing is counted over effective uses: ordinary Clips and every materialized Group Clip use, including invisible ones (section 4).
One accepted inspector edit is one adopted record, one history entry and one provider save; a refusal or no-op returns the original record identity and writes nothing (section 9).
Replacement changes the selected Clip only: other users keep their instance, controls, tracks and compiled member, and a shared source forks through the explicit independence plan (section 6).
Animation loss is reported by the pure planner and confirmed at the adapter; a cancelled confirmation adopts nothing (section 6).
An appearance edit writes the dirty fields of one explicit scope and leaves untouched held values and Effects exactly as authored (section 6).
The inspector allocates no identity of its own beyond the explicit fresh identities its planners ask for, and holds no second copy of the record.
A materialized Group Clip use is inspected, never edited as an ordinary Clip.
The authored entry policy is shown and never written: no landed owner or admission wrapper sets clip.entryPolicy (reported residual).
partitions: selection: ordinary Clip / Group occurrence / absent Clip / a selection kind the inspector does not own / no selection
sharing: sole use versus three effective uses across one ordinary Clip and two held Group Clip uses; Rejoin targets present, absent and self
replacement: compatible destination with no loss / incompatible destination dropping an animated control / unresolvable source / materialized child / missing Clip
confirmation: cancelled before adoption versus confirmed
timing: accepted move, accepted resize, fractional-millisecond refusal
appearance: one dirty field with held Effects and view values untouched; Effect added then removed
currency: superseded record, swapped provider, unmounted route
sequences: select Clip -> move -> resize -> fractional refusal -> Make Pattern Independent -> Replace (cancel) -> Replace (confirm) -> add Effect -> remove Effect -> Undo -> Redo -> reload
pilot panel independence on one fixture versus inspector independence on the same fixture, with identities minted from the same deterministic sequence
Group occurrence selection -> inspect instance uses -> ordinary Clip sections absent
oracles: The adopted record in the store and the bytes the provider received, compared field by field against the authored preimage.
Record equality between the inspector's adoption and the landed pilot panel's adoption of the same operation on the same fixture.
The exported .epe reopened through its importer: the retained instance's attributed compiled member is byte-identical before and after a shared-Clip replacement.
The stored v2 record read back through GET /api/shows?show-version=2 on the real authenticated route, plus the visible status line and the panel's rendered state.
History past/future entries and the counted PUT writes for accepted, refused and cancelled operations.
redEvidence: showClipInspectorV2Model.test.ts written against the model's required behaviour before the component existed; the Group-occurrence and Rejoin-target partitions failed until the materialized resolution and self-exclusion were implemented.
previewShowV2ClipReplacement tests failed with a missing export until the planner reported its loss.
The inspector component test failed on the move partition until the Clip fixture was shortened, exposing that the authored Clip filled Show End and the owner refuses a move past it.
The first e2e run failed on a strict-mode locator collision, showing the number field's Apply and Cancel affordances share the field's accessible name.

residualGaps: Entry policy is displayed, not editable: no landed pure owner or admitShowV2Pilot* wrapper writes clip.entryPolicy on an existing Clip, and the only landed writer is the non-exported writeClipFlags behind the #1041 update_clips command. Adding an owner and a Command variant to the closed admission is outside this slice's limits and needs the coordinator's decision.
Pattern instance clock (stutter), time scale and control values have no v2 edit owner, so the reused v1 leaf renders without its stutter row.

Inspector-versus-pilot equality is asserted at the adopted record and history, not at the returned affected-collection arrays, because the inspector calls the admission wrappers directly rather than through an injected submit seam.
Timeline gestures, Transition and Layout authoring, property lanes and Markers remain with slices 2, 4 and 5; the timeline surface stays read-only.
Authoritative committed-tip runner suites and Fable High review are the coordinator's.
